description: Annual depreciation rate by car age, estimated from the Finnish Tax Administration's applied taxation values (general retail value in Finland) for used cars imported into Finland.

source.name: Verohallinto / Finnish Tax Administration: Taulukoita ajoneuvojen sovelletuista verotusarvoista, henkilöautot 2024, 2025 and 2026 (January-September)

method: 113 970 tax decisions. log(value) regressed on age (piecewise linear, knots at 3, 6, 10, 15 and 20 years) with a fixed effect for each make + model + fuel + power class, so cars are compared only with the same model at a different age, plus a dummy for the year of the decision. Groups with fewer than 5 decisions or less than 2 years of age spread are left out. Rate = 1 - exp(slope).
caveats: Covers cars imported used, not cars sold within Finland. Importers favour cars in good condition with low mileage.

Typical mileage rises with age (median 85 000 km at 5 years, 164 000 km at 12 years), so the rates include normal mileage. The page reduces the value further only when the user drives more than 15 000 km a year.
Few battery-electric and hybrid cars are older than 6-10 years, so rates past those ages are extrapolated from petrol and diesel cars.
